firmware_obligations.obligation: instantiate the locked ESP-IDF i80 config at exact 20 MHz, CS=-1, 8-bit bus and rising-edge panel capture; exercise dirty-region and full-frame fixtures without waiting for TE, because panel contact 39 is deliberately open; no TE-synchronized or tear-free claim
firmware_obligations.handoff: H4-R2 joined review and the owning firmware phase

firmware_invariants.h4_join: H4-R2 consumes current R2 evidence only; retained R1 F3/F4 execution evidence is regression evidence, not current-topology proof
firmware_invariants.i8080: F5/F6 must instantiate and exercise the locked 20-MHz, 8-bit, CS=-1, rising-edge-capture display contract
firmware_invariants.physical_residuals: firmware may collect evidence but cannot mark an H5/H6/H8 residual complete without its required physical artifact
firmware_invariants.release: H3 completion does not authorize purchase, PCB placement/routing, fabrication or a final-product claim
